newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA reshuffles for international focus.
newsitem.headline: AGA reshuffles for international focus.

text.p: Swedish industrial and medical gas company AGA AB said on Tuesday it was reorganising the group to focus on international operations.

AGA said that from March 24 this year it would have three business areas which would be responsible for sales, profitability and growth, with each looking after research and development and business development in their own areas.

The three units would be manufacturing industry with its focus on the metal working industry headed by Jan Hammarlund, the process industry for metallurgical, chemical and food industries managed by leif Svensson, and health care led by Lars Kallsater.
"The purpose is to strengthen the group's focus on its customers and to adapt to their increasingly international operations," AGA said in a statement.
